notes: China Modern Dairy Holdings (HKEX: 1117) — China's largest raw milk producer (~2.7M tons/yr from ~40 mega-dairy farms). Affiliated with Mengniu (~60% controlling shareholder). Reports in CNY-millions (RMB) consolidated IFRS. Lists in HKD on HKEX. FY ends Dec 31. Heavy biological asset (livestock fair value gains/losses) drives reported earnings volatility — EBITDA shown ex-bio (operating). Net debt company-defined incl. lease liabilities.

periods.notes: FY20: Revenue RMB6.0bn (+11%), strong China raw milk pricing; EBITDA RMB1.66bn. Mengniu offtake agreement secured majority of milk.
FY21: Peak earnings — revenue RMB7.24bn (+20%), EBITDA RMB2.48bn (margin 34%), NI RMB1.03bn. Aggressive herd expansion + raw milk price highs.
FY22: Revenue RMB9.76bn (+35%) on continued herd expansion (>500k cows); EBITDA RMB2.9bn. Raw milk prices began declining 2H22.
FY23: Revenue RMB13.5bn (+38%) on volume + Mengniu price agreement; but bio-asset revaluation losses + raw milk price decline crushed NI to RMB175M. EBITDA ex-bio RMB2.27bn.

FY24: China raw milk surplus — prices fell ~13% YoY. Revenue RMB9.08bn (lower vs 23 due to revenue recognition restatement / one-time deconsolidation in prior year). Operating EBITDA RMB1.35bn. Net loss RMB1.47bn (bio-asset writedown + impairments). Leverage elevated at ~9x.
